events.title: Demo Update — A New Chapter Opens, and You Meet a Second Character
events.summary: A new chapter has been added to the free demo of 〈Was Silence〉. Beyond the first story, the path Ian walks stretches one step further. With every step the world opens a little wider, and along that path, you meet a second character. At the end of that road, where story still waits unreached, we meet again as the complete demo at Steam Next Fest, October 2026. events.title: Was Silence — What Remains When the Sound Fades
events.summary: Hello. This is Was Silence, by PWOK.Ian, a guitarist whose world is going quiet, meets others who have each lost a single sense — a 2D exploration visual novel that walks between silence and sound.We'll be quietly sharing the world and our progress here and on social from now on.Add it to your wishlist to hear the news first. A free demo is coming this fall.▶ Wishlist: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4552590
